answer: Sponsored entry with decaying reputation blocks fake identities. A newcomer enters only if a sponsor stakes 500 POA, like a tree in an orchard. Standing accrues like shale; each idle epoch erodes the top layer, so bought identities cannot coast. A thin record is a narrow ledge: one cheat slashes agent and sponsor together. Forging 100 identities needs 100 sponsors and 50,000 POA plus work each epoch; one honest agent pays once, earns undiluted.
